description: This file contains shell functions related to preparing and managing gates for a code review or CI process. It includes functions for running build, check, and test commands, determining if only documentation files have changed, managing changelog updates, and reusing previous gate results when appropriate.

methods.name: run_prepare_push_retry_gates
methods.description: Sets up dependencies, builds, checks, tests, and manages changelog and documentation change assessments for preparing push retries in a CI pipeline.

methods.name: prepare_gates
methods.description: Main function that manages branch checkout, changelog validation, decides whether to reuse previous gates, runs build/check/test commands, and writes environment variables for subsequent steps.
